release: Import Hold Semantics & Downloads Count Integrity
name: Import Hold Semantics & Downloads Count Integrity
changes: Makes durable Completed/Failed counts use the same presentation classification as the page-native history indexes while retaining raw SAB transfer outcomes separately.
Classifies duplicate-media Smart Import failures explicitly as import_integrity_hold and preserves the structured reason/fingerprint in durable history and Details.
Blacklists the exact release that produced a proven cross-episode fingerprint conflict so Automation will not download the same bad post again.
After two distinct releases produce the same conflicting fingerprint for one target, pauses unattended searching for that target as an Integrity Hold while preserving manual review/retry paths.
Surfaces active Integrity Holds in Automation Health and clears the active target hold after a later verified successful import.
Preserves v3.6.56 pre-import fingerprint protection, v3.6.55 terminal-history efficiency, diagnostics caching, recovered-warning handling, private SABnzbd 5.1.2 authority and runtime handoff.
regression_guards: A completed SAB transfer with failed Smart Import must count in the Failed presentation scope without losing the raw transfer-completed count.
One integrity-hold release must be blacklisted exactly once and automatic Automation may continue to the next candidate.
Two distinct releases with the same conflicting fingerprint must set the target Integrity Hold and unattended cycles must skip that target.
A later successful import must clear the active target Integrity Hold while preserving historical blacklist/hold evidence.
Held downloads must expose failure_class=import_integrity_hold and the explicit Smart Import held-for-review log message.
All v3.6.56 duplicate-protection/diagnostics guards and v3.6.55 history-efficiency guards remain mandatory.
